title: 词典 O
html:
词典 O

概述

本页收录以字母 O 开头的实用词汇，涵盖职场、日常和技术三大场景。每个词条给出词性、含义、常见搭配与例句，另设补充词汇、常用短语、易混淆词辨析与学习提示，便于按场景查阅与记忆。

职场与商务

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配 例句
optimize v. 优化 optimize performance We need to optimize the query performance before the launch.
outsource v. 外包 outsource development The company decided to outsource the QA testing to a vendor.
outcome n. 结果；成果 desired outcome The desired outcome of this sprint is a working prototype.
overhead n. 开销；管理费用 operational overhead Reducing operational overhead is a top priority this quarter.
onboarding n. 入职培训；新手引导 employee onboarding A smooth onboarding process improves new hire retention.
objective n./adj. 目标；客观的 business objective Each team aligns their work with the company's business objectives.
obligation n. 义务；责任 contractual obligation We have a contractual obligation to deliver by the end of March.
outperform v. 超越；表现优于 outperform competitors The new algorithm outperforms the previous version by 40%.

日常与社交

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配 例句
overwhelm v. 压倒；使不知所措 feel overwhelmed New developers often feel overwhelmed by the size of the codebase.
outgoing adj. 外向的；即将离任的 outgoing personality Her outgoing personality makes her great at client meetings.
occasion n. 场合；时机 on occasion On occasion, we hold team dinners to celebrate milestones.
outlook n. 展望；态度 positive outlook Maintaining a positive outlook helps during challenging sprints.
obstacle n. 障碍；阻碍 overcome obstacles The team overcame several obstacles to ship on time.
obliged adj. 感激的；被迫的 much obliged I'd be much obliged if you could review my pull request today.
offhand adj./adv. 随意的；即兴的 offhand remark I don't know the exact number offhand, but I can look it up.
outing n. 郊游；外出活动 team outing The annual team outing is scheduled for next Saturday.

技术相关

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配 例句
ORM n. 对象关系映射 use an ORM We use an ORM to simplify database interactions in our app.
OAuth n. 开放授权协议 OAuth 2.0 The login system implements OAuth 2.0 for third-party authentication.
overflow n./v. 溢出 stack overflow A recursive function without a base case causes a stack overflow.
open source adj./n. 开源的 open-source project Contributing to open-source projects is great for career growth.
orchestration n. 编排；调度 container orchestration Kubernetes is the industry standard for container orchestration.
output n./v. 输出 standard output The program writes results to standard output by default.
offset n. 偏移量 pagination offset Use an offset to implement cursor-based pagination.
opcode n. 操作码 execute opcode The virtual machine reads and executes opcodes sequentially.

补充词汇

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配 例句
obsolete adj. 过时的；废弃的 obsolete technology Flash has become an obsolete technology in web development.
omit v. 省略；遗漏 omit unnecessary details You can omit the optional fields when making the API call.
opt-in adj./n. 选择加入的 opt-in feature The dark mode is an opt-in feature in the settings panel.
outage n. 中断；停机 service outage The service outage lasted about 30 minutes during peak hours.
overhaul n./v. 彻底检修；大修 system overhaul The legacy system needs a complete overhaul to meet modern standards.

常用短语

短语 含义 例句
on the same page 达成共识 Let's make sure everyone is on the same page before we proceed.
out of the box 开箱即用 The framework provides routing out of the box without extra config.
on track 按计划进行 The project is on track for the December release date.
opt out 选择退出 Users can opt out of marketing emails at any time.
over the top 过分的；夸张的 The initial design was a bit over the top, so we simplified it.
on board 加入；同意 We got the stakeholders on board with the new proposal.
over and above 除…之外；额外 She contributed over and above what was expected of her role.

易混淆词辨析

词组 区别说明
objective vs. goal objective 更具体、可量化；goal 更偏向长远愿景。
obsolete vs. outdated obsolete 指彻底淘汰不再使用；outdated 指过时但可能仍在使用。
optimize vs. improve optimize 强调达到最优状态；improve 泛指任何程度的提升。

学习提示

  • optimize 是技术文档和系统设计中最高频的动词之一，名词形式为 optimization。
  • onboarding 既用于员工入职流程，也用于描述产品的新用户引导体验。
  • OAuth 是 Web 开发中几乎必知的认证协议，面试中经常考察其工作原理。
  • on the same page 是会议中最常用的短语之一，确保团队达成一致理解。
  • outage 是运维和 SRE 领域的核心词汇，通常与 incident 一起使用。
  • open source 不仅是技术概念，也代表一种协作文化和社区精神。
